newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers new 10-yr bond (BTP) for auction.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers new 10-yr bond (BTP) for auction.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it would offer a new 10-year fixed rate bond (BTP) paying a 7.75 percent coupon against the previous 8.75 percent coupon, at its regular end of month auction.
It said it would also re-tap existing issues of three and five BTPs and seven year floating rate certificates (CCT).
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* 5th tranche 1/10/96 3-yr BTPs paying a 7.50 percent coupon.
* 1st tranche 1/11/96 10-yr BTP paying a 7.75 percent coupon.
* 7th tranche 1/09/96 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 4.55 pct coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on Friday October 25.
Subscriptions for the CCT and 10-year BTP auctions close at 1100 GMT on October 30.
Subscriptions for the three and five year BTP auctions close at 1100 GMT on October 31. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
